title: narcissus linnaeanus subsp. italicus
intro: Narcissus linnaeanus subsp. italicus, commonly known as Italian daffodil, is a subspecies of the Narcissus pseudonarcissus species, characterized by its white trumpet-shaped flowers and narrow leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to exhibit various health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and anxiety. It is also believed to have therapeutic actions, including sedative and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of the Italian daffodil include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
